subject.title: [Feature]: Silent reasoning — exclude thinking content from session transcript

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class hidden reasoning persistence mode that runs model reasoning but excludes thinking blocks from durable and transcript-facing history, and where should provider-required replay state be preserved?
rationale: The remaining work changes session storage and transcript-consumer semantics across core/runtime/provider boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the public config and data contract.

options.title: Design core persistence policy
options.body: Add an explicit core policy for reasoning production, display visibility, durable transcript storage, and provider-private replay state, with docs and cross-surface tests.

options.title: Keep replay-only pruning
options.body: Limit token and signature handling to provider/context replay views such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98298 while leaving durable transcripts complete.

options.title: Rely on plugin filtering
options.body: Treat before_message_write or memory-plugin filtering as the supported workaround, accepting that core transcript APIs keep current behavior.

recommendation.title: Design core persistence policy
recommendation.body: Add an explicit core policy for reasoning production, display visibility, durable transcript storage, and provider-private replay state, with docs and cross-surface tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from current and historical transcript, reasoning, and provider-replay work.
